title: Not sure if it works.
text: Not sure if it works.. This is a cool concept. I'm not sure if it works all that well. The bar is hollow. It is much lighter weight than I expected. It's a decent size and fits comfortably in your hand as you work it. I rubbed onion on my hand, did a sniff test then used this. Only the faintest of odors lingered. Was that the water and friction? Was that the stainless bar? I don't know. Also, I wish this had a base to set it on when on counter.

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Gourmet Odor Removal Bar, One Size, Stainless Steel,5 quarts
features: Durable Stainless Steel: This odor removal bar is crafted from brushed Stainless Steel. It measures 4 x 5-3/4 x 1-1/4 inches.

Elimates odor from hands: simply rub the bar between your hands with or without water, especially in between your fingers where smells can reside, just as you would with a bar of soap and neutralize the odor.
Ideal for use after handling smelly foods: ideal for use after handling garlic, onions, fish or other smelly foods.
Dishwasher safe: this odor removal bar is dishwasher safe, making clean up quick and easy.
Lifetime Limited included: This odor removal bar comes with a 1-year Hassle-Free replacement and lifetime limited.
